pending_commit.commit_message: trunks: added PinWeaver vendor commands to trunks_utility. PinWeaver is a Cr50 feature for hardware backed brute force resistance of PINs. This allows for PIN authentication on CrOS devices without reducing the security of the platform. This adds the reset_tree, insert_leaf, remove_leaf, try_auth, reset_auth, get_log, and log_replay commands to trunks and provides a command line utility for sending these commands to Cr50. trunks: added pinweaver_client binary This adds the /usr/sbin/pinweaver_client binary to the trunks ebuild so the PinWeaver feature on Cr50 can be used or tested from command line.
